# Bundled skills that ship without an exercise set: the backlog.
#
# One line per skill: "<slug> <reason>". The list may only shrink. Write the skill's
# set under evals/<slug>/ and delete its line; never add a skill here. A new skill
# arrives with its set or TestEveryBundledSkillHasAnExerciseSet fails.
contract-design no set yet: needs a fixture where an interface change breaks a caller the tests do not cover
dependencies no set yet: needs a vendored-versus-written fixture and a licence check the verifier can run offline
domain-language no set yet: needs a fixture whose existing vocabulary the verifier can grep for drift
external-integration no set yet: needs a fake service that fails in the ways the skill names (timeouts, partial pages, retries)
interface-depth no set yet: needs a before and after measure of interface size that tells a shallow wrapper from a deep module
shared-state no set yet: needs a deterministic concurrency fixture whose race the verifier can provoke without timing luck
structural-boundaries no set yet: needs an import-graph check the verifier can run on the fixture
